oracle.stop_timing: before each remaining lap, including the current lap
oracle.inventory: unique physical sets; removed sets cannot be reused
oracle.cost: independent generated base pace, age slope, curvature, wear cliff, weather penalty, cold tyre cost, stop loss and rejoin delay
oracle.information_advantage: Oracle sees the full generated world, including future conditions and nonlinear tyre response. Planner receives ordinary state and linear historical summaries. Regret is diagnostic, not a calibrated real-race accuracy claim.
oracle.excluded: No production stint simulator, lap-cost constants, ranking function or probability distribution is used to score a plan.

metrics: independent finite-set regret seconds, median and p90
linear-family regret separately from distribution-shift families
total planner runtime and p95 per checkpoint
closed-loop physical failures and recommendation changes before execution
missing or internally contradictory output contracts

hard_gates.impossible_recommendations: must be investigated individually; no improvement claim based on dropping impossible outcomes from regret
hard_gates.candidate_vs_baseline: same manifest, worlds, observations and scoring code; no holdout retuning

limitations: This is an intentionally small deterministic engineering benchmark, not a fitted simulator of any EA title or a real driver.
Synthetic histories are supplied directly at the model boundary; this does not test database learning, UDP parsing or the installed user interface.
Baseline plans without physical set IDs receive the most favorable unique-set assignment consistent with their compound sequence; this is explicitly optimistic.
An unavailable or physically impossible plan has no finite regret and remains counted separately.
Weather future in the oracle is known; production weather beliefs are uncertain, so weather regret cannot be interpreted as an optimality defect alone.
